GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead half clear, held together turn, headed Straightening Up found little and dropped out # pulled up Lame
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden further forward; led. Rdr reported the gelding raced far too keenly with its head up when leading through the early stages and refused to settle. He said his mnt commenced to weaken soon after straightening and, when he became concerned that something may be amiss with the gelding, he did not pressure it over the final 200m. A post-race vet exam revealed the gelding to be lame (2/5) in the off foreleg. Trainer was advised that a vet clearance will be required prior to being permitted to barrier trial or race again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped another runner. Rider reported intention was to settle forward, however after beginning awkwardly settled towards the rear. Had difficulty obtaining clear running in the early part of the straight before shifting out near the 200m and finished strongly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well pressed on to lead half clear, held together turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed passing 200m, kept on well, tiring final 50m # led/faded

Jumped Well , Went Forward Slight Lead on rail @ 800m. skipped 1 length Clear on Straightening Up . Same 200m but peaked there and was Not Knocked About at all last 100 (vetted - no significant abnormalities) # led/run ended 200m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that after obtaining the lead, his mnt was able to set moderate sectionals throughout the early and middle stages. He said that passing the 600m  his mnt quickly came under pressure and was disappointing as it did not respond to his riding, before weakening in the straight. Post race vet no abs other than a minor abrasion on the off-hind fetlock. Stable representative advised that the gelding had recovered well from the event, however, to spell.
